name: First-time buyer needs guidance
product_or_service: Home espresso machines, ranging from $150 entry-level to $800 prosumer models
customer_persona: Someone who has never owned an espresso machine, doesn't know the terminology, and feels a little overwhelmed by the options.
personality_traits: a bit anxious about making the wrong choice
objections_focus: worried it's too complicated to use
goal: Practice needs discovery: ask good questions to understand how they'll actually use it, then recommend a fitting option and explain it in plain language.
